dimensions.assessment: Applies to private elementary and secondary schools, local educational agencies, and charter schools nationwide that choose to apply for grants or distribute opioid reversal drugs.
dimensions.evidence: Eligible entities include private elementary and secondary schools, local educational agencies (LEAs), charter schools that are LEAs, and consortia of LEAs.

dimensions.assessment: Provides funding resources and requires emergency response plans, education, and reporting, creating moderate operational changes for participating schools.
dimensions.evidence: develop and implement educational programming or resources to promote student and community knowledge of cardiopulmonary resuscitation

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes federal grants for purchasing drugs and educational programming, though specific funding amounts are not stated in the source text.
dimensions.evidence: award grants, on a competitive basis, to eligible entities-- (1) to purchase opioid overdose reversal drugs... and (2) to develop and implement the educational programming

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new grant program administered by HHS and mandates new reporting requirements to federal information systems for covered educational institutions.
dimensions.evidence: This bill establishes a grant program to provide schools with opioid overdose reversal drugs and requires reporting related to the distribution of such drugs.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes one-year grant periods and ongoing annual reporting requirements for the Secretary of Health and Human Services.
dimensions.evidence: A grant awarded under this section shall be for a period of 1 year.

missing_information: Total authorization amount or specific appropriation levels for the grants.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes a competitive grant program for schools to purchase opioid overdose reversal drugs and develop educational programming, while also requiring certain federally funded schools to report distributions of these drugs to federal information systems.
